mechanism.event_authority_boundary: resolved_internal_engine, resolved_internal_engine_class, resolved_internal_engine_artifact_sha256 and engine_identity_sha256 are reserved and rejected when supplied by causal Entry data
mechanism.engine_selection_authority: separate EngineAdmission supplied by deterministic EntityOS/HCU control plane
mechanism.provider_request: event may carry only an optional admitted provider request hint; it must match the separate EngineAdmission when present and cannot self-grant authority
mechanism.artifact_authority: EngineAdmission artifact digest must independently match admitted_engine_artifacts for the selected engine identity
mechanism.typed_entry_identity: entry_admission_sha256 is independently rebound to replay-stable entry_event_sha256 before routing
mechanism.route_identity: HCU_CAUSAL_ROUTE_IDENTITY/v3 binds event, router policy, exact admitted engine identity and deterministic routing result under the explicit hash serialization profile
mechanism.downstream_echo: inference receipt must echo serializer, event, concrete Entry admission, route, engine identity/class and exact artifact digest

source_falsifiers_present: event self-mints any reserved engine authority field -> REJECT
requested provider disagrees with separate EngineAdmission -> REJECT
EngineAdmission artifact differs from independent artifact registry -> REJECT
Typed Entry event identity differs from independent admission binding -> REJECT
same causal event with rotated admitted artifact -> stable event identity but distinct engine/route identity
downstream receipt with altered Entry admission, event, artifact or serializer identity -> REJECT
